heading: Tightest T_wcet: both together
text:
### Tightest T_wcet: both together [LNLS.8.3]

When both `realtime` and `linear_scan: false` are active:
- Beta joins are **O(1)** per assert/retract — J_max = 1 proven by
  LNLS.3.3, pool-allocated, both index directions always active,
  fallback scan unreachable.
- All series are O(1), included in RT T_wcet calculations.
- The intern table is locked. No rule produces a novel string
  ([LNLS.5.5]), and a novel string arriving on an asserted fact is refused
  rather than interned ([RTCT.12.4]).
- All hash tables are pre-sized when the engine goes live.
- `J_max` replaces `N_max` as the dominant beta cost parameter.
- The supersedure lookup is always O(1), with no fallback scan ([LNLS.5.3]).

The T_wcet formula from [LNLS.7.1] applies with the additional
guarantee that all memory was pre-allocated and no allocation path
is reachable in LIVE.
